GENERAL INQUIRY

How can we help?

Normal response target: five business days. Careers and investor inquiries should use their dedicated pathways for faster routing.

Fraud warning: Trust only correspondence from an approved @perpach.com address. Never send money in response to an unsolicited message. Perpach will never ask you for fees, deposits or financial commitments via email or messaging.

Please do not submit identity documents, banking details, confidential technical data, or investment funds.

ROUTING

Dedicated pathways.

Different inquiries require different expertise. To ensure your message reaches the right team as quickly as possible, we maintain dedicated pathways for specific inquiry types.

  • Investor & strategic partners — Use the investor pathway for all investment-related inquiries. This ensures your profile is reviewed by the appropriate team.
  • Careers — Visit our careers page for current vacancies and recruitment information. General employment inquiries can be submitted through this contact form.
  • Partnerships & suppliers — For structured partnership discussions, visit our partnerships page and submit a partnership inquiry.
  • Media — Journalists and media representatives should identify themselves as such in the contact form. We aim to respond to media inquiries within 48 hours.
